_comment: Registry of article-publishing platforms. automation_tier: 1 = real API, no gatekeeping, publishes unattended. 2 = real API but needs an approved developer app first (external lead time, like Meta App Review). 3 = editorial/community platform, no autopost path — skill produces a draft for manual submission. Region matching reuses config/countries.json's regions (caucasus, central_asia, western_europe, eastern_europe).

platforms.name: Собственный блог Daily Yolk
platforms.api_notes: WordPress REST API or Ghost Admin API — either gives real unattended publish. Requires the blog to exist first (not built yet, see program plan open question).

platforms.name: Telegram-канал
platforms.api_notes: Telegram Bot API — simplest and most reliable channel here, no editorial review, no app-approval process.

platforms.name: LinkedIn (страница компании)
platforms.api_notes: Requires LinkedIn Marketing Developer Platform approval — external review process, similar lead time to Meta App Review. Do not treat as available until approval is confirmed.

platforms.name: Medium
platforms.api_notes: Medium closed its public Publish API to new integrations — verify current account-level access before relying on this; treat as tier 3 (manual) unless confirmed otherwise.

platforms.name: VC.ru
platforms.api_notes: Editorial/community-moderated, no public autopost API. Read by RU-speaking business audiences relevant to Caucasus/Central Asia restaurateurs.

platforms.name: Habr
platforms.api_notes: Editorial/community-moderated (corporate blogs need a paid subscription; personal posts go through community rating). No autopost path.
